description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 4th-level spells, Elemental Focus (Water)

Benefit: As long as you have an elemental (water) spell of 4th level or higher in your known spells and have at least 4 MP in your MP pool, you may control water at-will using half your caster level, sculpting it into any shape you desire. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting elemental (water) spells.

system.requirements: Ability to cast 4th-level spells, Elemental Focus (Water)
